mapper.select: SELECT * FROM notification WHERE user_id=#{userId} AND id=#{id}
mapper.update: UPDATE notification SET read_at=COALESCE(read_at,CURRENT_TIMESTAMP) WHERE user_id=#{userId} AND id=#{id}
UPDATE notification SET read_at=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE user_id=#{userId} AND read_at IS NULL
mapper.select: SELECT type,enabled FROM notification_setting WHERE user_id=#{userId} AND channel='IN_APP'
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO notification_setting(user_id,type,channel,enabled,updated_at) VALUES(#{userId},#{type},'IN_APP',#{enabled},CURRENT_TIMESTAMP) ON CONFLICT(user_id,type,channel) DO UPDATE SET enabled=EXCLUDED.enabled,updated_at=EXCLUDED.updated_at

INSERT INTO notification(id,user_id,child_id,type,source_event_id,title,link,status,retry_count,created_at) SELECT #{id},#{userId},#{childId},#{type},#{sourceEventId},#{title},#{link},'QUEUED',0,#{createdAt} WHERE NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM notification_setting WHERE user_id=#{userId} AND type=#{type} AND channel='IN_APP' AND NOT enabled) ON CONFLICT(user_id,type,source_event_id) DO NOTHING
mapper.update: UPDATE notification SET status=#{status},failure_reason=#{reason} WHERE id=#{id}
